name: Shallan’s Shadow Burst
body:
School illusion (shadow) [shadow]; Level magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a black ribbon)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 10 ft. burst
Saving Throw Will disbelief (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Cold shadows dims the light of the area for a few moments, chilling everyone caught within to the bone. Any creatures in the area that fails the saving throw takes 1d6 points of Strength penalty for 1 round/level and is dazzled for 1 round.
